## Summary

Describe the change and the user or maintenance need it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] `bash scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] Relevant behavior has unit or integration coverage.
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible changes.

## Compatibility

Describe any CLI, output, exit status, platform, or compatibility impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the project standards.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive logs are included.
